title: Financial Crime Business Analyst
text: Financial Crime Business Analyst at Ambition Technology (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: $700 - $750 p.d.). Our client is one of a 4 leading banks seeking an experienced financial crime BA to join their team to assist across critical projects. You will be working across all financial crime prevention streams including sanctions, anti-money laundering (AML), KYC, anti-bribery and corruption. The role will be focused on strengthening the financial crime risk management to comply with regulatory obligations. Responsibilities: Develop detailed Business Process Specifications, Business Requirements and System Functional/Non Functional Specifications that will drive the desired change to business process, system enhancement / development activities Plan, estimate, and report on Business Analysis activities & deliverables. Review and revise documentation in light of any new information and/or changes to initial assumptions, including implications for project time, cost, quality & risk. Recommend and justify the functional design to address the business needs to ensure the business understands the proposed design Coordinate and participate in the analysis of business documents to ensure effective solutions are delivered to the business Deliver effective solutions and business processes to provide BAU and project support for customers' requirements and objectives Experience Strong experience as a Business Analyst - 5+ years Experience within Financial Crime with AML/CTF is a must Proven track record of project experience end to end (concept feasibility/business case - delivery/implementation) Agile experience SQL experience for data extracts would be ideal Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills Mixture of Business BA and Technical BA experience
